name: com.scraperwatch/scraperwatch
title: ScraperWatch
description: Scraper usage and success-rate data; daily MCP Registry stats and MCP server tool-change history.

tools.name: find_scrapers
tools.description: Which tracked scrapers have the most recorded 30-day users for a website? Uses the filtered official Apify Store export; data_updated is the saved snapshot timestamp, with age/status in evidence. Returns usage, run completion and billing fields, not live tests. min_success_rate: zero includes unknown rates; positive thresholds require known rates.

tools.name: compare_scrapers
tools.description: How do two to five exact actor IDs compare? Uses the filtered official Apify Store export; data_updated and evidence describe the saved snapshot date and age. Reports usage, eligible run completion and compatible result-event rates; unknown/excluded IDs are indistinguishable. Different targets have no winner; listed rates are not total cost.

tools.name: best_scraper
tools.description: Which tracked actors lead recorded run completion, usage and qualifying price for a website? Uses the filtered official Apify Store export; data_updated and evidence give snapshot date and age. Completion candidates require 300+ runs and 20+ users; price candidates also require 95%+ completion and known result-event rates. No live tests or output-quality measure.

tools.name: compare_scraping_apis
tools.description: What do saved scraping API tests report? Uses the saved API benchmark summary and frozen matched ScraperAPI/ScrapingBee report. generated_at/window_days date the aggregate only; matched evidence has its own window. Returns completion/content checks and latency with separate denominators and limitations; no current vendor requests.

tools.name: compare_rag_extractors
tools.description: How did Firecrawl, Jina Reader and DIY extraction score on saved documentation fixtures? Uses the saved RAG benchmark and hash-checked table audit. Per-vendor last_run dates are source observations; generation time is unknown. Returns text/code/table scores and latency with limitations; audit may be unavailable or stale. No live tests or cost. Jina paused 2026-11-20 (terms): historical.

tools.name: compare_proxy_providers
tools.description: What captured proxy offers cover a product type and optional monthly GB? Uses research/e5/proxies.json; observed_on dates each captured offer, with observations outside the past 30 days omitted. Estimates full saved package bills only; IP offers are separate and unknown costs remain null. No live prices or performance measurements.

tools.name: actor_history
tools.description: How have one tracked actor's usage, run completion and primary event price changed by day? Uses compact official Apify Store history exports; dates are snapshot filenames, not verified per-actor observation times. days is a UTC calendar window ending today (1-365). Missing days stay absent; event rates are not total cost or necessarily per result.

tools.name: mcp_server_changes
tools.description: What tool changes did our daily tools/list check record for one public MCP server (registry name or remote URL)? Covers servers on our published panel or watch list; status says if not. Returns per-day tools added, removed, changed, instruction changes, possibly breaking schema edits (heuristic), Atom feed URL and change-log link. Saved data; no request to the server.

tools.name: mcp_registry_stats
tools.description: How large is the official MCP Registry and how many servers were added, removed or changed per day? Uses our daily registry snapshots (latest version per server); days = most recent snapshot days (1-30). Earlier totals are derived from the latest count and daily diffs. Saved data; no live registry request.

tools.name: list_websites
tools.description: Which websites are in the filtered scraper export, and how many actors and summed 30-day users does each have? Uses saved official Apify Store statistics from latest.json. Counts reflect that snapshot, not live coverage; this response has no date field. Summed actor users are not deduplicated across actors.
